# Implementation Plan

> Superpowers protocol: spec first, plan second, tasks sliced small, TDD before implementation, review before release.

## Architecture

Short explanation of the chosen path.

## File Map

- Create:
- Modify:
- Test:

## Tasks

- [ ] Write a failing test for the next behavior.
- [ ] Run the test and verify the failure is the expected one.
- [ ] Implement the minimal code to pass the test.
- [ ] Re-run the focused test.
- [ ] Re-run the surrounding test suite.
- [ ] Capture review and gate evidence.

## Definition of Done

- [ ] Tests pass
- [ ] Review evidence captured
- [ ] QA evidence captured
- [ ] Security evidence captured
- [ ] Release notes captured
